consequence.statement: The flags still work in 1.17 but will be removed in Cilium 1.18, so usage must move to the Cilium CLI for sysdump collection.
consequence.remediation: Use the Cilium CLI to gather a sysdump from a K8s cluster.

original.statement: The bugtool flag --k8s-mode (and related --cilium-agent-container-name, --k8s-namespace, --k8s-label) is deprecated and will be removed in Cilium 1.18; use the Cilium CLI to gather a sysdump from a K8s cluster.

decision.reason: [ev-a7d9e5f931b3] says the bugtool flag `k8s-mode` and the related flags `cilium-agent-container-name`, `k8s-namespace` and `k8s-label` are deprecated in 1.17 and will be removed in Cilium 1.18. It also says to use the Cilium CLI to gather a sysdump. Nothing says the flags fail or are ignored in 1.17, so the right kind is deprecation and it needs review, not action. The proposed fix and low severity match the evidence.
